component.name: Yalla Video
component.summary: Fast, privacy-first video downloader for YouTube and 1000+ sites

description.p: Yalla Video is a fast, privacy-first desktop downloader for YouTube and over 1000 other sites. Grab single videos, full playlists, or entire channels in one go — with filters, search, and bulk selection.

Pick any quality up to 8K, choose video or audio-only formats (MP4, MKV, MP3, M4A, WAV, and more), and download multi-language subtitles (embedded or sidecar SRT/VTT). Smart Mode picks the best format automatically; manual mode gives full control over codec, frame rate, and resolution.

ul.li: Parallel downloads with per-job bandwidth limits
Batch URL paste and clipboard-aware tray for one-click captures
Proxy and SOCKS support, browser cookie import
yt-dlp and ffmpeg install and update themselves — no setup required
Available in 12 languages with light, dark, and themed UIs
Open license (MIT), no telemetry, no account required

screenshot.caption: Home view: paste a link and choose quality, format, and subtitles
Active downloads with progress, speed, and pause/resume controls
Browse and bulk-select videos from entire channels
Configurable settings: themes, languages, format defaults, and proxy
About: version info and project links

description.p: First Flathub release. Renames the app ID to io.github.monzer15.YallaVideo to meet Flathub conventions.
Improved download manager, expanded site support, refreshed UI themes, and stability fixes.
